content:
mike-eng: Quick heads-up — planning to ship v2.14 tomorrow 09:00 PT (2026-04-02 09:00 PT). tagging CS/marketing for coordination. main items: model routing fix, cache key change, and a small console layout tweak.

release-bot: CI build passed: build-7823. Artifact: https://ci.redwood.local/artifacts/7823 :white_check_mark:

tom-marketing: @mike-eng thanks — can you drop a 1-paragraph blurb for customers and a 2-line internal notification? we want to schedule the product email for 10:30 PT.

mike-eng: Will post a short blurb by EOD. For internal note: "v2.14: improved routing for mixed-batch workloads, reduced cold-start latency ~20%".

nina-cs: Who's the smoke owner? we need confirmation on SLO checks and a quick rollback playbook. also need to know if any customer-facing behavior changes require CS scripts.

alice-qa: I'll own smoke for the UI/console flows. plan: run smoke-suite.sh against canary (20% traffic) then full rollout. Smoke checklist in the QA doc: https://wiki.redwood.local/qa/v2.14-smoke

sara-sre: SRE note — rollout window is 09:00–10:15 PT. We'll route 20% to canary for 10m, check latency & errors, then 50% for 15m, then 100% if green. If errors spike >3% or P99 latency > 1.5x baseline, stop and rollback.

dave-ops: I'll be the button presser. I'll also monitor the LB health checks and KV cache fill rates. Rollback command (one-liner):
```
redwoodctl rollout cancel --env prod --release v2.14 && redwoodctl rollout start --env prod --release v2.13
```

mike-eng: @dave-ops thanks. note: feature-flag for console tweak is behind `ff/ui-refresh`. we'll keep that off in main rollout until CS approves messaging.

emily-docs: Docs will publish the changelog + API note by 08:00 PT tomorrow. Can someone confirm if there are schema changes?

mike-eng: No schema changes. only routing and UI copy. Docs edit: add note about improved routing and an example on cost tradeoffs.

nina-cs: Can we get a quick support script? "If customer reports increased latency after 09:00 PT: verify canary status, check region routing (region-switch log), and run `redwoodctl revert` if needed." I'll draft and share in this thread.

devex-bot: Checklist reminder — confirm: [x] CI green, [ ] canary smoke owner assigned, [ ] marketing copy, [x] rollback steps available.

alice-qa: Canary smoke owner = alice-qa (me). I'll post smoke run results in #eng-releases thread and ping @nina-cs.

tom-marketing: I'll draft the email and share the subject lines here at 17:30 PT. Need the 1-paragraph blurb from @mike-eng to finalize.

mike-eng: Blurb posted: "v2.14 improves request routing to reduce latency for mixed short/long sequences and includes a minor console refresh. No API changes; rolling update tomorrow 09:00 PT. Reach out to CS if you see regressions."

nina-cs: Drafted support steps and short FAQ. dropping into this thread: "1) Check canary health, 2) Ask for repro + request_id, 3) If systemic, initiate rollback (see rollback cmd)."

release-bot: Scheduling note — deployment window reserved: 2026-04-02 09:00–10:30 PT. Pager duty: dave-ops on call.

mike-eng: Final alignment — everyone ok with the plan? Please :thumbsup: if yes or flag issues.

sara-sre: :thumbsup: I'll be watching latency dashboards and autoscaling.

dave-ops: :thumbsup: ready to trigger.

tom-marketing: :thumbsup: marketing synced for 10:30 PT send.

emily-docs: :thumbsup: docs scheduled 08:00.

nina-cs: :thumbsup: CS on standby.

mike-eng: Great — we'll proceed. I'll post a final "go/no-go" 30 minutes before window.
